name: mp0_prefill

engines.holon: this repository at the record's commit (std.moe@1; the store and kernels per arm: arms_*.json)
engines.freetoken: FreeToken 21d9578bde22 (bench/setup_baselines.sh offload: torch 2.14.1+cu130, [accel]); --moe-strategy fused (all experts resident) or --moe-cache-rate (offload); the gated arm adds --max-extend-length 4096, its default chunk is 8,192
engines.model: Qwen3-30B-A3B Q4_K_M (unsloth/Qwen3-30B-A3B-GGUF); the 16 GB lock's: UD-IQ3_XXS

commands: python spikes/moe_prefill/prefill.py run --arms spikes/moe_prefill/arms_<card>.json --model <gguf> --out <dir>/timed --rounds 2 --reps 5 5 3 --holon-python <holon venv python> --freetoken-python <freetoken venv python>
python spikes/moe_prefill/prefill.py run --arms spikes/moe_prefill/kv_<lock>.json --model <gguf> --out <dir>/kv --rounds 1 --reps 1 --lengths <a prompt below the lock's context>
